+title: A clear catalogNotLoaded error before the registry's first load()
+---
+## What
+Before `registry.load()`, `runner.start` throws `unknownAgent(available: [])`, and `AgentsTool.make` gives "No agents are installed now." with no hint that the host forgot `load()`.
+
+- Add `AgentRegistry.isLoaded` (true after the first successful `load()` or `reload()`).
+- `AgentRunner.start` throws a new `AgentRunnerError.catalogNotLoaded` before the first load. `AgentsTool.make` throws the same error.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/CLI/AgentsCLIOperations.swift` has a `switch` over `AgentRunnerError`: add the new case, with a text in `Tool/AgentsToolText.swift`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `runner.start` and `AgentsTool.make` before `load()` throw `catalogNotLoaded`; after `load()` they work as now.
+- [ ] The CLI start before `load()` gives a clear error.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Cases in `AgentRunnerTests.swift`, `AgentsToolDescriptionTests.swift`, and `AgentsCLITests.swift`.
+- [ ] Run `swift test -Xswiftc -warnings-as-errors`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m3db1rcjtm8h1rs5q09yd1yr
+  text: |-
+    Research:
+    - `AgentRegistry.current` holds a `Generation` with a build number. The empty build has number zero. Each build that swaps in has a number larger than zero. Thus `isLoaded` can be `current.number > Generation.empty.number`, with no new state.
+    - `AgentRunner.start(_:prompt:)` reads `registry.catalog()`. Before load, it throws `unknownAgent(available: [])`.
+    - `AgentsTool.make` reads `context.startableAgents()`. Before load, the description gets "No agents are installed now."
+    - `StartAgentCommand.execute` checks `context.startableAgents()` before it calls `runner.start`. Before load, that check gives the unknown-agent corrective first. Thus the CLI needs its own check of `registry.isLoaded` before the startable check, in addition to the new case in the switch.
+    - Docs that state the old behavior: the doc comment of `AgentRunner`, the doc comment of `AgentRunnerError.unknownAgent`, and docc RunningAnAgent.md / LoadingTheCatalog.md.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-25T22:30:20.306915+00:00

     - `StartAgentCommand.execute` checks `context.startableAgents()` before it calls `runner.start`. Before load, that check gives the unknown-agent corrective first. Thus the CLI needs its own check of `registry.isLoaded` before the startable check, in addition to the new case in the switch.
     - Docs that state the old behavior: the doc comment of `AgentRunner`, the doc comment of `AgentRunnerError.unknownAgent`, and docc RunningAnAgent.md / LoadingTheCatalog.md.
   timestamp: 2026-09-25T22:30:20.306915+00:00
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m3db8tgasw0qbjv1ef7cxh1e
+  text: |-
+    Implementation landed (TDD). The new tests failed first for the correct reason: `unknownAgent` was thrown in place of `catalogNotLoaded`, `AgentsTool.make` threw no error, the CLI gave "No agent has the name ...", and `isLoaded` was false after `load()`. Then the tests passed.
+    - `AgentRegistry.isLoaded` compares the build number of `current` with the number of the empty build. It adds no new state. A cancelled `load()` keeps it `false`.
+    - `AgentRunner.start` checks `isStopped`, then `registry.isLoaded`, then the catalog.
+    - `AgentsTool.make` throws `AgentRunnerError.catalogNotLoaded` before it reads the catalog.
+    - `StartAgentCommand.execute` checks `registry.isLoaded` after the blank-prompt check and before the startable-agents check. Without that check, the unknown-agent corrective comes first. The switch in `start(on:)` also has the new case.
+    - New text: `AgentsToolText.catalogNotLoaded`.
+    - Docs: the doc comments of `AgentRunner` and `AgentRunnerError`, the docc articles RunningAnAgent.md and LoadingTheCatalog.md, and the plan.md §9.3 runner bullets.
+  timestamp: 2026-09-25T22:34:11.850045+00:00
